publications.reporter_found: Elsewhere, Jack Strand still did not receive team work, but he is expected to play half of Saturday’s preseason game. Chris Blair received most of Jahan Dotson’s first-team snaps during red-zone work, giving him another opportunity to make his case for a roster spot.
publications.lineupbeat_impact: Chris Blair took most of Jahan Dotson's first-team red-zone snaps during one joint practice. The report does not say why those snaps were available or for how long, and it does not establish that Blair has moved ahead of Dotson.
publications.author: Darius Hayes

publications.reporter_found: Anthony Richardson led the Colts' second-team offense down the field for a field goal score as time expired, and then the second-team defense followed suit with an impressive tip drill interception to wrap up training camp festivities at Grand Park once and for all.
publications.lineupbeat_impact: Anthony Richardson led the Colts' second-team offense on a field-goal drive during the final day of training camp. The report does not establish whether this was a planned rotation, part of the quarterback competition or a depth-chart change, so it does not support moving his fantasy outlook in either direction.
